June 17, 2018 - By Russell Anderson
Kenneth Tropin increased its stake in Apple Inc (Put) (AAPL) by 1974.1% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Graham Capital Management Lp bought 114,024 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Kenneth Tropin held 119,800 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $20.10 million, up from 5,776 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Graham Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc (Put) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $928.18B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.03% or $1.96 during the last trading session, reaching $188.84. About 33.10M shares traded or 10.09% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
